model_under_test: OC133 official-snapshot chemistry batch scorer over NIST/PubChem rows

comparator_baseline.name: chemistry official-snapshot null/wrong-field negative controls
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: Use each row's preregistered null, wrong-compound, or wrong-string control under the same residual metric.

uncertainty.metric: mean absolute residual across official snapshot tasks
uncertainty.method: deterministic official snapshot replay envelope; blocked unless target-blind/prospective source separation exists
